Customer Service · AI says:

If a product is unsuitable, Wild Earth accepts change-of-mind returns within 80 days of the original order, provided it is unused, in “as new” condition, and has all original tags and packaging. Eligible returns may receive store credit or a refund to the original payment method.

Key limits: underwear is generally non-refundable/non-exchangeable unless faulty; bras are exempt; shoes may only be tried indoors; safety equipment, gas canisters, and special-order/custom items are non-returnable. Sale items remain eligible under the 80-day policy.

Direct exchanges are unavailable because stock cannot be guaranteed. Buy the replacement first, then return the original for a refund after it reaches the warehouse.

Include your receipt or Tax Invoice number, contact details, and reason for return. Send it to Wild Earth’s returns address in Burleigh Heads, Queensland. Return postage is your responsibility; tracked or registered shipping is recommended. Returns are processed within 3 business days of warehouse receipt, with email confirmation.

For faulty or defective items, submit a warranty request with proof of purchase; the team will review it and advise the next steps.
